largeSpec.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group (an additive commutative group with finitely many elements) equipped with a measurable space structure. For $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$ and $\eta \in \mathbb{R}$, $\mathrm{largeSpec}(f, \eta)$ is a finite set of additive characters $G \to \mathbb{C}$; according to its docstring, it is the $\eta$-large spectrum of $f$.
